provenance.method: Fresh visual transcription of the 300 dpi scan: Arabic words, Bengali translation and every upper sign anchored to its letter.

unresolved.question: Row 0: the waqf sign after الْاَنْهٰرُ is a small ط with a small loop under it; encoded as ؕ.
The ৬ printed beside each ringed-wedge often looks enclosed in a ring at scan resolution; recorded as plain ৬ (enclosure none), as on other pages.

Page legend (partly faint) lists ১ এক আলিফ, double-ring ১ দম ফেলিলে এক আলিফ, ২ দম ফেলিলে দুই আলিফ, ৩ তিন আলিফ, ৪ চার আলিফ, ৬ দম ফেলিলে তিন / না ফেলিলে এক; letter legend not readable, default labels used.

Band ২ signs (row 0 over the tanween of جَنّٰتٌ and nun of مِنْ, row 5 over اِنْ, row 6 over nun sakin of فَلْيَنْظُرِ and الْاِنْسَانُ, row 7 over the tanween of مَّآءٍ, row 8 over مِنْ) sit over noon sakin/tanween before an ikhfa letter; labelled with the legend text for ২ anyway.
Row 3: band ১ printed between فِيْ and the ت of تَكْذِيْبٍ; anchored to the ي of فِيْ (madd).
Row 5: band ৩ printed over the alif of اَدْرٰىكَ; anchored to the آ of وَمَآ (madd munfasil). ম and ১ over اَدْرٰىكَ both anchored to رٰ.
Row 5: in النَّجْمُ the band reads ক গ close together over ج; ক anchored to ج, গ to the shadda nun.
Row 7: مِنْ before بَيْنِ carries a small meem (iqlab); written as مِنْۢ.
Rows 0, 3, 4, 9: anchors for band signs printed slightly left of their letter follow nearest-letter judgement (e.g. গ over وَّرَآئِهِمْ anchored to the shadda waw rather than the nun of مِنْ).
Ruku sign ع beside the 85:22 verse circle, the QR code beside row 5, the margin ruku box and the 'মানযিল-৭' label are not encoded; header box prints no Arabic surah name.
